name: 77802 · Bryan, TX
findings: ZIP 77802 (Bryan) has 134 nonprofit organizations. 54 of them (40%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 41 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (22% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 77802 (Bryan) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
